subject: INSPECT statement
notes: §14.9.22.4 GR13 (identifier-1/3/4 in the storage of the TALLYING counter: result undefined, Annex A.2 item 21 d)); §4.4 2) makes the run unit conforming. WiseOwl COBOL documents and pins its behavior (docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-INS1, D-INS2; kb/Work PB1907; owner 2026-10-01, GnuCOBOL 3.2 measured): each TALLYING operand counts from the state after the earlier operands stored their counters, and a format 3 replacing half (GR19) reads identifier-1 as the tallying half left it; a statement whose counters overlap nothing it reads stays the one shared GR8 cycle.
